status: Source-grounded next implementation path; not a production readiness claim.
objective: One LAX agent identity with independent reader, writer and responder histories; Hollywood is primary human/agent communication; retain native execution, administration and cooperation.
currentEvidence: Actual writer deliverable plus concurrent status and proactive communication completed in the original three histories.
Original long-turn completion recovered from native metadata with zero new model turns.
Real follow-up delivered after withholding its writer completion notification; one original submission, no replacement writer turn.

Bounded retrieval passed actual PostgreSQL pagination/Unicode/revision checks and a 57-second native question in original histories. Reader explicitly fetched recorded work across three chunks; responder answered; writer started zero turns.

sourceFindings.fact: Existing durable agent context is independent of rooms and work; retain this identity and explicit adoption mechanism.
Mature tools and native effect provenance depend on captured delivery, role, persistent context and independently observed executor. Importing its tool declarations alone is insufficient.
Current native source v2 validates one bound execution per delivery. Purpose contexts require coherent source/ownership integration, not permission bypasses.
Candidate blocks legacy claim for purpose agents and uses internal work material. Existing goal/work/admin/cooperation paths are absent from its model tool surface.
Delivery obligation, reviewed product work and native execution are separate existing records. Internal material must reference these authorities, not become a second work acceptance ledger.
Current terminal path couples finished inference, terminal text and delivery response. Three-context integration must split execution evidence from responder publication.
The fork already supports cold-resume dynamic tools and an immutable tool ceiling. Preserve original histories at an idle boundary when changing declarations.

implementationOrder.outcome: One native execution and effect core reused by the purpose runtime.
changes: Extract/reuse existing authenticated tool/effect, executor-attestation, activity and cancellation machinery from Connector; do not fabricate a fake active delivery or independently reimplement all handlers.
Retain the existing writer context as its persistent execution identity; add purpose bindings without changing agent identity on room, responsibility or goal changes.

Define and validate explicit purpose/native-turn/source-material ownership against live placement/executor state. Installation/controller metadata attests process facts; model text grants no authority.

implementationOrder.outcome: Existing Global and peer capabilities remain usable with one outward communicator.
changes: Writer retains native execution/editing, administration, provisioning, goals/work, reviews and collaboration tools through the shared core.

Outbound message and delegation tools create durable communication intents with original operation and authorized audience/recipient. Responder publishes them and exposes actual accepted receipt; queued intent is not accepted peer work.

Reader receives attributable human/peer obligations and scoped observations, updates existing commitments and communicates relevant new findings to the writer through versioned material rather than raw user steering.
Peer completion, human question and correction must not replace or falsely complete the original objective. Room membership alone does not assign every task or require acknowledgements.

implementationOrder.outcome: Execution settlement, work review and communication settlement remain distinct.
changes: Link internal handoff material to original delivery and optional canonical goal/work/attempt. Reviewed work acceptance remains hb_work authority.
Native turn completion records execution facts. Verified work contribution may make response material ready. Only accepted responder publication resolves its communication obligation.
Implement targeted Stop and recovery across affected purposes, explicit authority/role revision refresh and retained unknown external effects without automatic replacement execution.
Do not reserve scarce execution capacity solely for pending peer/human communication, and do not impose a fixed two-slot enterprise architecture.

implementationOrder.outcome: A real Global-to-peer deliverable proves the complete path before rollout.
changes: Use a disposable installation with actual account/auth, administrative, Git/SSH, workspace, controller and artifact readiness; verify, do not infer from a health endpoint.
Ordinary human request -> Global creates peer and room through native tools -> peer executes real artifact work and collaborates -> Global verifies/reviews -> responder reports to original audience.

During that same work, ask a human status question, send a relevant peer finding and exercise reconnect/Stop on original operation identities. Inspect actual model tools, roles, event attribution and separate activity.
Only then progress to two humans/two hosts and NextComp phone qualification; preserve previous services and every deliberate stop.

boundaries.contextMaterial: Internal semantic handoff/read material; not independent business work acceptance.
boundaries.role: Canonical role data is tool-read; immutable purpose instructions and executable tool ceilings agree. Business responsibility changes preserve context identity.
boundaries.delivery: Attributable original request/reply obligation with durable receipts.
boundaries.work: Existing optional goal/work/review structure; completion of inference is not acceptance.
boundaries.activity: Native actions form a separate stream from intentional room communication.
boundaries.unknown: Observe exact original operations and executions; do not replay uncertain effects.
boundaries.migration: Candidate only until parity proof. Preserve durable history, pairings, current controls and stopped schedules. No database rewind or all-live default switch.

validationPolicy: Prefer the actual end-state native journey. Small PostgreSQL/protocol checks establish bounded reads and fencing only; they do not establish semantic stability, collaboration or autonomous-enterprise readiness.
